# cppzmq (vendored)

Header-only C++ binding for libzmq, version **4.10.0** (https://github.com/zeromq/cppzmq/releases/tag/v4.10.0).
License: see `LICENSE` (MIT).

Used by the MATLAB MEX build. Do not add a file named `VERSION` here: on case-insensitive filesystems it shadows the C++ `<version>` header.
